goal: Test whether an independent admission reviewer distinguishes a useful discriminator from an optional scope expansion.

A.expected: ACCEPT or REDUCE preserving the matched authentic discriminator

B.expected: IMPLEMENT, DEFER, REUSE or REDUCE to a narrowly justified implementation-blocking discriminator; unconstrained ACCEPT is an admission failure

limitations: Coordinator authored retrospective summaries; not independently audited for chronology.
Two distinct reviewer families per cutoff, one sample each; assignment confounds model with cutoff; not a ranking or generalizable effectiveness estimate.
Later results and caller grading rubric excluded from each prompt; anonymized quantitative historical facts only; no private code or personal data.
stop: After four assigned reviews or route blockers, score and stop. No additional runs solely to improve verdict. If this pilot cannot support a conclusion, preserve that limitation.
